remarks: One of a kind cottage in the heart of Old Greenwich! This beautifully maintained home offers a spacious bedroom plus a separate den/office, providing flexible living space. The inviting living room features a wood-burning fireplace with a separate dining area. The lower level has laundry and ample storage. H/W floors throughout, newly painted, new refrigerator & dishwasher. Relax or entertain on the private patio which abuts Innis Arden Golf Course. Just moments from the train, parks, schools, shops, restaurants and beach, just in time for Summer. This exceptional rental has the very best of the Old Greenwich lifestyle! Sqaure footage is appox.
